about: Drinks that stay listed but sort to the end of their shelf, never open a first row, never stand in a hero, and never take an office-entry lead. A drink is demoted when a name rule matches its 品名 (case-insensitive), or when it is in look. look lists drinks whose still reads as wine, judged by eye against public/drinks/<slug>.webp; the catalog text alone cannot tell a wine bottle from a red soda. allow lists drinks a name rule catches but whose still does not look like alcohol. Every look and allow entry says why; the export check fails on a slug missing from the catalog, an allow entry no rule catches, or a slug in both lists.
